findings.claim: S&P Global Mobility 5月更新將北美2027輕型車產量預測下調33.9萬輛，理由是油價情境持續影響至2027年（需求、生產成本、供應鏈承壓）
findings.source: autoinformed.com - May 2026 Light Vehicle Production Forecast is Down Again (S&P Global Mobility)
findings.excerpt: North America's vehicle production outlook was reduced by 13,000 units for 2026 and 339,000 units for 2027.

findings.claim: ITR Economics預期北美輕型車產量2027約-2.1%、2028約+4.6%，維持在約1,500萬至1,560萬輛區間
findings.source: heattreat.net - Automotive and Heavy-Duty Truck Forecasts Point to Two Different Paths Through 2028
findings.excerpt: ITR expects annual production to remain in a relatively narrow range of approximately 15.0 million to 15.6 million units through 2028.
